questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {由曲线} y = 1 - x ^ { 2 } \quad ( 0 \leq x \leq 1 ) \quad \text{与}x,y \quad \text{轴所围成的区域}，\text{被曲线} \\ y = a x ^ { 2 } \quad a > 0 \quad \text{分为面积相等的两个部分}，\text{则}a=（） \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} s_1&=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{a-1}}}(1-x^2-ax^2)dx=\frac{2}{3\sqrt{a+1}}\\ s_2&=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{a}{a-1}}(\sqrt{1-y}-\sqrt{\frac{y}{a}})dy=\frac{2}{3}(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{a+1}})\\ \text{令}s_1=s_2\ \text{解出}a&=3 \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设直线} y = a x \text {与抛物线} y = x ^ { 2 } \text {围成的图形的面积为} s _ { 1 } , \text {它们与} x = 1 \text {围成的} \\ \text {图形面积为} s _ { 2 } , \text {并且} 0 < a < 1 , \text {如果} s = s _ { 1 } + s _ { 2 } \text {达到最小，则} a = \text {（）} \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l}A=\int\limits_{0}^{a}(ax-x^{2})dx+\int\limits_{a}^{1}(x^{2}-ax)dx=\frac{1}{3}a^{3}-\frac{1}{2}a+\frac{1}{3}\\s^{\prime}=a^{2}-\frac{1}{2},s^{*}>0,\ \text{解出}a=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{计算由曲线} y ^ { 2 } = 2 x \text{与} y = x - 4 \text{所围成的图形的面积（）}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：两个曲线的交点是} & (2,-2), (8,4) \\ A &= \int\limits_{-2}^{4} (y+4-\frac{y^{2}}{2}) dy = 18 \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{由抛物线}y=-x^{2}+4x-3\text{及其在点}(0,-3)\text{和}(3,0)\text{处的切线所围成的图形的面积（）}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解：}\quad\text{切线}y=4x-3\ \text{及}y=-2x+6\ ,\ \text{二切线的交点是}(\frac{3}{2},3)\\&A=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{3}{2}}\{4x-3-(-x^{2}+4x-3)\}dx+\int\limits_{\frac{3}{2}}^{3}\{-2x+6-(-x^{2}+4x-3)\}dx\\&=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{3}{2}}x^{2}dx+\int\limits_{\frac{3}{2}}^{3}(x-3)^{2}dx=\frac{9}{4}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {由曲线} y = 1 - x ^ { 2 } \quad( 0 \leq x \leq 1 ) \quad\text{与}x,y \quad\text{轴所围成的区域}，\text{被曲线} \\ y = a x ^ { 2 } \quad a > 0 \text {分为面积相等的两个部分，则} a = \text {（）} \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：} & s_1=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{a+1}}}(1-x^2-ax^2)dx=\frac{2}{3\sqrt{a+1}}\\ s_2=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{a}{a+1}}(\sqrt{1-y}-\sqrt{\frac{y}{a}})dy&=\frac{2}{3}(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{a+1}})\\ \text{令}s_1=s_2\ \ \text{解出}a&=3 \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{介于直线} x = 0 , x = 2 \pi \text{ 之间，由曲线} y = \sin x \text{ 和} y = \cos x \text{围成的图形的面积（）}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：两个曲线的交点为} x=\frac{\pi}{4}, x=\frac{5\pi}{4} \\ A=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} (\cos x-\sin x) dx + \int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{5\pi}{4}} (\sin x-\cos x) dx + \int\limits_{\frac{5\pi}{4}}^{2\pi} (\cos x-\sin x) dx = 4\sqrt{2} \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{由摆线}x=a(t-\sin t),y=a(1-\cos t)\text{的一拱}(0\leq t\leq 2\pi)\text{与横轴所围成的图形的面积（）}

options.label: A
options.html: \pi ( a ^ { 2 } + 1 )

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \pi a ^ { 2 }

options.label: D
options.html: 3 \pi a ^ { 2 }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}A&=\int\limits_{0}^{2\pi a}ydx=\int\limits_{0}^{2\pi}a(1-\cos t)d(a(t-\sin t))=\int\limits_{0}^{2\pi}a^{2}(1-\cos t)^{2}dt\,,\\&=a^{2}\int\limits_{0}^{2\pi}(1-2\cos t+\frac{1}{2}(1+\cos 2\,t))dt=3\pi a^{2}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}A&=\int\limits_{0}^{\infty}|e^{-x}\sin x|dx=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi}e^{-x}\sin xdx-\int\limits_{\pi}^{2\pi}e^{-x}\sin xdx+\cdots\\&=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\int\limits_{k\pi}^{(k+1)\pi}(-1)^{k}e^{-x}\sin xdx\\&\quad\int\limits_{k\pi}^{(k+1)\pi}e^{-x}\sin xdx=-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x}(\cos x+\sin x)\big|_{k\pi}^{(k+1)\pi}=\frac{1}{2}(-1)^{k}e^{-k\pi}(e^{-\pi}+1)\\&A=\frac{1}{2}\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}e^{-k\pi}(e^{-\pi}+1)=\frac{1}{2}\frac{e^{\pi}+1}{e^{\pi}-1}\end{aligned}
